Privacy

What happens to your files when you use OurSolver.

Effective 2026-10-29.

File processing

The tools process selected files locally in your browser. This version does not upload file contents to a processing server. Files and generated results are held in browser memory while the page is open. Clearing the tool or closing the page releases its references; downloaded copies remain on your device. This is not a guarantee of secure memory erasure.

Website requests

Your browser requests site pages, scripts and images from the hosting provider. The provider may process ordinary connection information such as IP address, requested URL and browser information for delivery and security. Local file contents are not included in these requests by the tools.

Cookies, analytics and accounts

This release does not add advertising, analytics, accounts or application tracking cookies. It does not save selected files in local storage. Hosting-level security features may operate independently. If analytics or advertising are added later, this notice must be updated before enabling them.

Your choices

Use only files you are permitted to process. You can close the page at any time and remove downloaded files using your device's file manager. For tool limitations, see Help.
